headline: Community Learning Facilitator
summary: Community learning facilitator with three years running Alternative Learning System sessions and livelihood trainings in Davao del Norte. I facilitate adult classes in barangay halls, keep learners' records, and work with community leaders and social workers to reach out-of-school youth and adults.

experience.title: Community Learning Facilitator
bullets: Facilitate Alternative Learning System sessions for about 60 out-of-school youth and adults in four barangays.
Organise livelihood trainings on food processing and basic bookkeeping with local partners.
Keep learners' attendance, portfolios and progress records for the accreditation exams.
Visit families with the barangay social worker to bring back learners who stopped attending.

experience.title: Youth Volunteer Coordinator
bullets: Recruited and scheduled volunteers for weekend reading and sports activities.
Listened to young people's concerns and referred them to counsellors when needed.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Social Work
